source: Worked by hand from PLAN.md sections 4 and 5 by an agent at the user's instruction, before comparing with the code. A should still check each case independently.

blocking.description: One-way arcs. The cheapest path S-A-B-T (cost 3) blocks S-A-T and S-B-T (cost 11 each), so 1 of 2 is delivered while max flow is 2.

path_limit.description: Healthy diamond, max_paths 1, F1 alone (15 Mbps): 10 on A-B-D, A-C-D still free.

util_cap.description: util_cap 0.9 on capacity 10 gives effective capacity floor(9.0) = 9.
